about.title: Thirteen years between foreign capital and Bangladeshi power.
about.lede: I develop utility-scale power projects in Bangladesh — solar, storage, LNG and gas. Foreign sponsors bring the money and the technology; I make the project real in-country: the land, the grid connection, the ministry approvals, and a PPA a lender will actually finance.
